content.intro: In this lesson, you will study regular expressions with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you choose standard APIs that match the meaning and constraints of the data. In this lesson, focus on pattern syntax and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: The standard library provides dedicated types for common domains. Match the API to the data—for example, `java.time` for dates, `BigDecimal` for exact decimal arithmetic, and locale-aware formatting for user-facing values. Apply that reasoning specifically to pattern syntax and confirm the result with the example or a targeted test. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.
